title: Contact and Protocol
author: Wendell Dunmore
blurb: Jude Blackwood, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
